author: creeperslayer431
body:
IMO- Appeals are meant to help players try to get things off their record so they don't look like they are rood or just not the greatest player and it gives them a chance to change.

Bans being appealed by Email is not the best IMO Plus you can't appeal Warns and Kicks. 

Players should be be given the opportunity to  testify their infractions to try to get those off there Record.

I think giving players the chance to appeal on the website is easier and works better for staff and them then Email and so they can not just appeal bans, I can Understand that if staff has proof players should not be able to.appeal but just give players this opportunity to change their ways and try to be a better person.

Thank You,
-SWAG23JorDan

title: [SUGGESTION] Making Appeals On Website.

replies.author: speakmm
replies.body: As for warns and kicks, they can be appealed - however they are usually always correct, seeing as most of them are given out at the time of offence. As for appealing via the website - this would be a nice feature however it makes it too easy for someone who was hacking to simply put an appeal through. When you use emails, it actually somewhat separates those who were unfairly banned and actually want to play again, copared to those who were infringing rules and were justly banned.

replies.author: Joao_Victor
replies.body:
Remember this: You can only register for the forums in-game, if you're banned, how will you register?

But if a system like this can be implemented, then this would work really well.

Also, Avicore uses a new appeal system which allows Managers+ to appeal certain infractions, which could be used to appeal kicks.

However, kicks are very different from bans, kicks are basically a warning saying "Don't do this or you'll be punished"  since kicks don't have any major affect, it's difficult to get it appealed unless the staff member that punished you gets involved, and if you don't have any evidence.
